name: a-workflow-that-cannot-be-read-is-not-an-empty-one
breaks: a workflow file the API would not hand over reads as a file with no jobs in it, so every check it declares drops silently out of the bar, and a check nobody waits for cannot block a merge. That is the defect this reading was written to fix, arriving by the path meant to fix it (#1342, L214, L98)
